title: IT AI Startup Serval Hits $3B Valuation Following $150M Series C
summary:
The latest funding event brings the total capital raised by the enterprise IT automation startup to $277M, marking its third round of investment in one year. Serval, which provides AI agents to manage IT operations such as access management, saw its valuation climb to $3B from $1B in December 2025 during the Series C round led by Sequoia.

The company will hire more than 500 employees over the next 12 months and expand its operations into London, San Francisco, New York, and Austin. Serval's clients include Lucid Motors, Fox and WPP, some of whom are using the agent platform to replace legacy IT service management software.
